theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (h : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (γ : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (a b : ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h U → ContDiff ℝ 1 γ → 0 < a → (∀ t, t ≤ a → γ t = γ 0) → (∀ t, b ≤ t → γ t = 0) → tsupport h ∩ closedBall ξ b ⊆ U → IsTestField U (fun x ↦ (h x * γ ‖x - ξ‖) • (x - ξ))
